I don't know. The question says 25 degrees, so I used 25.
You're right that the question says 25 degrees, but the ideal gas law needs Kelvin, not Celsius.
Kelvin? I don't get it, how do I get Kelvin from 25?
To convert Celsius to Kelvin, add 273.15 to the temperature. So, 25°C is 298.15 K.
Oh okay. So V is 0.25 times 0.0821 times 298 over 1, about 6.12 liters instead of 0.513. Thanks.
